title: Cattle mutilations done by humans

tellings.quote: Same thing with cattle mutilations. Linda Moon thinks those are aliens. No, we're doing that.

plain: The cattle mutilations, cases where farm animals are found dead with organs cut out, are said to be done by humans and not by aliens. Steven Greer, a UFO researcher, tells Michels this flatly, without naming a source, and says the researcher Linda Moulton Howe is wrong to think aliens are behind them. If true, it would mean people are staging these cases.
